title: LS Power Announces Key Senior Management Promotions
主要内容: LS Power announced executive leadership changes to align its gas-fired generation fleet with its focus on decarbonizing the U.S. energy sector. Nathan Hanson was promoted to President, LS Power Generation, overseeing a 13,000 MW conventional generation fleet. Hanson joined LS Power in 2011 and previously served as Managing Director of Energy Management and Regulatory Affairs. LS Power also highlighted key senior management promotions, including Anthony Hammond, Marc Kline, and Marjorie Philips in senior vice president roles. CEO Paul Segal emphasized the role of efficient, flexible gas-fired generation in maintaining grid reliability and affordability amid renewable energy integration. The company's gas generation platform is well positioned to accelerate the energy transition by managing the intermittency of weather-dependent renewables such as wind and solar power.
